## Chapter Six

Initiate



Three days later the two of them entered the yard as usual, Dyson had not or would not elaborate on the bomb he had dropped, soon after his admission , the klaxon had sounded to bring them in , and for the last two days he had not been present during yard time, from time to time while everyone else went out for exercise Dyson would disappear, not even Lopez knew what the old man was doing. But today here he was, and they quickly walked towards the wall. Lucas’s mind was buzzing with a million questions as they approached the spot with the symbol.



Dyson walked over, checked the symbol and turned to his student. “Always check the symbol, if you ever come here and its crossed out, that means it has been compromised” he said again scanning the yard as usual. “So, you probably want me to elaborate” the old man asked a smirk now present between the thick beard. Lucas just nodded. Waiting for him to expound on his admission.

“Your father was passing information to my people, that is what got him killed, first before you ask, that wasn’t what got him killed, though had they found out it would have, what got him killed was his boss embezzling from the Department of Finance and framing your father” Dyson stated adding more thundering discoveries to his statements. “What” was all Lucas could say, his mind still trying to process this, he had not thought about his father in months and now , he thought he had put it behind him, he had finally laid his father to rest and here was his teacher dredging up old wounds and worse, telling him that his father was innocent. “Who the hell are you?” Lucas almost yelled, anger welling up inside him. Who was this guy to bring up his father, how dare he tell him the man he thought was guilty, the man who he thought responsible for putting him here, was innocent Lucas thought part of him feeling guilty for the anger?



“I won’t answer that yet, I will, but not today because that answer will get you killed or worse” he said. Infuriating Lucas “What the hell can you tell me, I mean , what right do you have to tell me this now, why not sooner” he said Why not before I condemned him for my situation he thought but leaving it unsaid to the old man, but he could see the truth of his thoughts in Dyson’s eyes, he knew what he meant. Dyson took a breath “Because, I tell you what you need to know , as you need to know it, I reveal things when I feel you can handle them, this is what I do, and this is why I do it, your training will change from here on out, it will seem odd the things I will teach you, but I need your trust, I know its a lot to ask, but remember I have trained you to survive, I think I am owed some trust” Dyson finished. The anger overtook Lucas “Fuck you” he said and walked off, leaving Dyson standing there. How dare this man ask this of him he thought, who the fuck did he think he was, Lucas had come along way, he knew how to defend himself, he knew how to keep a secret he thought walking across the yard. Fuck him He thought continuing to stew aren’t I owed some trust dammit, aren’t I owed some answers who the fuck does Dyson think he is.



Lucas walked over to the weight area and vented his anger and bitterness in the only productive way he knew how to, he lifted, and he lifted hard, straining his muscles, forcing them to burn as he continued to vent internally over Dyson and his god complex. Dyson left him alone for there remaining time in the yard. Upon returning to the cell Lucas walked close to Dyson, looking up at the camera. “I will trust you, but you will owe me answers” he said and then laid down to read.



He didn’t want to let him off the hook, but he at least owed him that, he owed him the ability to explain, and he had to admit to himself, if he wasn’t going to tell him now, there was a reason, Dyson had been good to him, had taught him , had taken him under his wing when he didn’t have to. So, he would allow him to explain in his own twisted timeline, but he didn’t have to like it. Laying in the bed he could feel his muscles tighten for the abuse he had put them through.



He lifted himself up off the bed and stretched out Dyson watching from his bed. Lucas couldn’t tell what the old man was thinking and didn’t really want to know, but he couldn’t worry about that, for now he had his own guilt to deal with and that was going to take some time.



The next day, Lucas began scanning walls and posts and floors, looking for markings like the one in the yard. In the hall as they shuffled towards the mess once again, he noticed another upside-down V on a post, this one had a drawing of an eye, but it was crossed out. Lucas registered it and he put a mental note to ask Dyson at exercise.



“It means the cameras are blind there” he said as they stood in there spot later. So know you have found Blind and Mute, there are more if you look , as you find them feel free to ask, as of right now we are going to start talking history, however, this history could get you killed should you repeat it, do you understand me” he asked his student. Lucas didn’t understand but nodded anyway, talking bad got it he thought and waited for the old man to continue.



Lucas braced against the cold Is it fall or winter? He wondered, it was so easy to lose track of time in here, he honestly didn’t know if he had been here for months or years, it felt like years he thought coming back to focus when Dyson spoke. “You have been told how the corporations saved this country and rebuilt it, while that is partially true, what you don’t know is these four corporations that we so worship and that built the foundations of the departments that are the four pillars of New America, they architected the fall of this country so that they would be able to rebuild it.” He said and waited to allow Lucas to process this. “What” he said and then chided himself, god that was stupid, but what the hell was he supposed to ask, it was like saying god was the devil, but also god his young mind couldn’t quite wrap his head around it. He had spent his entire life being told that these four companies had been there savior’s, celebrating holidays that lauded their virtues to the country and now his teacher, the man who saved him in this place was telling him, they were the ones who destroyed it. “How is that possible?” Lucas finally stammered out, asking the only question that really mattered.



Dyson smiled and shook his head “oh kid, there is so much you don’t know” and over the next four days he proceeded to enlighten the young man on the history that no one ever talked about.



On the fifth day Lucas lay on his bunk before lights out looking at the ceiling, trying to make sense of how any of this was possible, how incredible the story, he felt dubed, betrayed but ultimately saddened over the story.



Lucas organized it in his own head in case one day he would have to retell it , as this was a story that could never be commited to a physical medium, he was sure anyone who did that would be killed or tried as a traitor.



He could hear Dysons words over and over in his head.



“Listen up kid, because I am only going to repeat this once, this is not a story for everyone nor would everyone want to hear it, it’s a story about betrayal, about corporate greed and the utter failure of our political system.” He had started, instantly getting Lucas’s interest. “In the earlier part of the two thousands, or hell maybe a little earlier, its hard to remember since most of the records have been altred or sealed, laws began to change , allowing companies the ability to legally donate more money to campaigns, this gave way to allot of corporate influence in government, in the three largest corporations at that time and you know them well EnviroCorp, DynaTech, Polyhedron all eagerly donated millions to get senators and congressmen in there pockets. In fact, it was Anna Domingez at Polyhedron who hosted the first meeting between the three of them, the purpose of this little alliance was to steer government in whichever direction would best suit their businesses. At this time news on TV had long since stopped being objective, the parties were deeply divided, and everyone needed money for tv spots and internet advertising. No one seemed to even read news stories, if it wasn’t onliny and wasn’t a paragraph or less then no one seemed to notice it.” Lucas thought back to the first day when he had started his story, shaking his head at how people could have allowed so much to be taken from them after ages of fighting against it. Shaking himself he concentrated on remembering Dyson’s words. “It was about this time that Roger Etherton , who was the CEO of EnviroCorp was having a few issues with the Enviromental Protection Agency, a department in the old government that looked out for the earth, and he approached his friends in this little unofficial alliance and pitched a crazy idea, Roger wanted to see if they could get a president elected, but not just any president, one who was completely pro business and in there pockets. The other two CEO’s at first resisted but as they watched the state of politics and the country more and more, they realized it could be possible. It was a simple plan, they would encourage someone who normally wouldn’t run, to run, they would buy him, they would own him, and they would use every dirty trick they had to get him elected. And it worked. For one term he presided over the country changing along with a few key people in the senate the three of them were able to alter laws that allowed them to truly and freely do business without the worry or fear of oversight or government intervention.”



The thing is kid, not everyone does this for the good of the people or the good of the country, some assholes just want money and fuck everyone else” Dyson had said to the young man, trying to explain to the confused boy how a few people could mortgage away there future and even more so the country. He didn’t know why or how, and he was too young to be cinical about the intentions of man, but he continued to let the story lay out, listening even thought he knew the ending wasn’t a happy one. “After a year of seeing the type of power they were able to weild using their money and connections, they were hooked, but like anyone who gets a taste of power, they wanted more. And it wasn’t long before they began to plan for the next election, ensuring they had control of more polititians, allowing them the ability to control more of not only there business but the business of running the country, competitors suffered at there hands, and any oversights, or violations they made to any national law was quickly overlooked and swept under the rug and this happened for years” Dyson had stated “Now around this time, no one is sure if they were responsible for the bioPlague or just were in a position to take advantage of it, officially it was released in New York. LA, Bancock, DC, London, Moscow and multiple other places two years before the first cases were even noticed from what we are able to glean, by that time it had spread over most of the world and within six years one in four were dying or dead, some of the reports said it was supposed to have hit up to half, but no one knows who released it or what its true purpose was, there was speculation that a left wing environmental group was trying to save the planet by killing most of the population of the world.



But what it did , was offer a window, where the three corporations took advantage of this event to pass laws and take power, there is not a lot of information during that time , but what we do know is at the end of it, Black Dragon had joined the other three as the military wing and the country was taken over, a bloodless coup as the entire congress, senate and the president himself signed over control of the country to the board.” It was at that point that Dyson had paused, letting Lucas reflect on his words. The young man remembered thinking how crazy that was, how could you own someone so completely they would give up the country and in his mind he couldn’t understand. Dyson had completed his story with the formation of the four departments which had gone through and annexed under government law all corporations within the old united states, bringing them all into state sponsored ownership. The four members of the biggest corporations now had a country instead of just a business Lucas thought and then remembered stories of banned lists of books and movies and arrests as well as mass executions under the guise of unpatriotic intent, in fact it seemed whenever someone did something that displeased the government it was called unpatriot intent. For some reason this caused him to smile, he was full of unpatriotic intent now he thought.



The next day they talked very little, they trained as usual and Dyson disappeared during exercise time, leaving Lucas to the ministrations of Lopez and Porter. Upon returning to his cell he found Dyson sitting on his bed with a chess set fully assembled and ready to go. “This is our next lesson my boy” he said motioning Lucas to sit down. It took only a few hours to explain to Lucas the various pieces, how they move and the basic stragy of the game, And by the time lights out happened, he had been able to at least loose a game semi competently.

But looking back, he remembered it was the first time they had laughed, it was the first time they had felt almost like family, and it was before everything changed.
